'''Nektarios N. Tavernarakis''' ([[Greek language|Greek]]: Νεκτάριος Ν. Ταβερναράκης) is a Greek bioscientist, who studies [[Ageing]], [[Cell death]], and [[Neurodegeneration]].<ref>{{PubMedAuthorSearch|Tavernarakis|N}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=Nektarios+Tavernarakis |title=Nektarios Tavernarakis - Google Scholar |access-date=2015-11-23}}</ref> He is currently Distinguished Professor of Molecular [[Systems Biology]] at the Medical School of the [[University of Crete]], in [[Heraklion]], Crete, Greece, and President of the [[European Molecular Biology Conference]] (EMBC).<ref name="EMBC">{{cite web|url=https://embc.embo.org/governance/officers/ |title=EMBC|website=Embc.embo.org |date=12 February 2021 }}</ref> He is also Distinguished Member of the [[Foundation for Research & Technology – Hellas|Foundation for Research and Technology]], and the founder and first Director of the Graduate Program in [[Bioinformatics]] of the University of Crete Medical School. He has served as Chairman of the board of Directors at the Foundation for Research and Technology, and Director of the Institute of Molecular Biology and Biotechnology, where he is heading the Neurogenetics and Ageing laboratory. He was elected Vice President of the [[European Research Council]] (ERC) in 2020,<ref name="erc.europa.eu">{{Cite web|url=https://erc.europa.eu/about-erc/erc-president-scientific-council|title=ERC President & Scientific Council|date=Jun 30, 2026|website=Erc.europa.eu|access-date=November 7, 2026}}</ref> and Chairman of the [[European Institute of Innovation and Technology]] (EIT) governing board and executive committee in 2022.<ref name="eit.europa.eu">{{Cite web|url=https://www.eit.europa.eu/news-events/news/nektarios-tavernarakis-appointed-eit-governing-board-chair|title=Nektarios Tavernarakis appointed EIT Governing Board Chair &#124; EIT|website=Eit.europa.eu|access-date=November 7, 2026}}</ref>

==Early years==
Nektarios Tavernarakis was born and grew up in Megali Vrisi,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.originalcrete.gr/en/article/megali-vrusi|title=Megali Vrisi, Towns and villages - Heraklio|website=Originalcrete.grn|access-date=November 7, 2026}}</ref> a small village in the municipality of [[Gortyn]]a, about 30 Km to the south of [[Heraklion]], and graduated with honours from the 1st High School of Heraklion (Kapetanakeio).<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://1lyk-irakl-new.ira.sch.gr/|title=ΑΡΧΙΚΗ|website=1lyk-irakl-new.ira.sch.gr|access-date=November 7, 2026}}</ref>

== Biographical information ==
Nektarios Tavernarakis completed his undergraduate studies at the Department of Biology of the [[Aristotle University of Thessaloniki|Aristotle University]], in [[Thessaloniki]], Greece (graduated with honours in 1989), and obtained his PhD degree from the Department of Biology of the [[University of Crete]], in Heraklion, Greece, having received the best PhD Thesis Award. He trained as a postdoctoral researcher at the Department of Molecular Biology & Biochemistry of [[Rutgers University]] in New Jersey, USA. He has made notable contributions relevant to [[cell death]], [[neurodegeneration]] and [[ageing]], documented in the scientific literature.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.researcherid.com/rid/B-9684-2013 |title=Nektarios Tavernarakis B-9684-2013 |publisher=ResearcherID.com |date=2014-01-02 |access-date=2015-11-23}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://orcid.org/0000-0002-5253-1466 |title=Nektarios Tavernarakis (0000-0002-5253-1466) - ORCID &#124; Connecting Research and Researchers |publisher=ORCID |access-date=2015-11-23}}</ref>

In 2020, Nektarios Tavernarakis was elected vice president of the [[European Research Council]] (ERC),<ref name="erc.europa.eu"/> and in 2022, he became chairman of the [[European Institute of Innovation and Technology]] (EIT) Governing Board,<ref name="eit.europa.eu"/> He is a member of the [[European Molecular Biology Organization]] (EMBO),<ref name="EMBO">{{cite web |url=http://www.embo.org/members/find-a-member |title=EMBO members |publisher=Embo.org |access-date=2015-11-23 |archive-date=2020-03-21 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200321182646/http://www.embo.org/members/find-a-member }}</ref> the [[European Academy of Sciences]] (EurASc),<ref name="EurASc">{{cite web|url=https://www.eurasc.eu/members/ |title=Members – European Academy of Sciences |date=13 April 2022 }}</ref> [[Academia Europaea]],<ref name="AE">{{cite web|url=http://www.ae-info.org/ae/User/Tavernarakis_Nektarios |title=Academy of Europe: Tavernarakis Nektarios |publisher=Ae-info.org |access-date=2015-11-23}}</ref> the [[Academy of Sciences Leopoldina|German National Academy of Sciences-Leopoldina]]<ref name="Leopoldina">{{cite web|url=https://www.leopoldina.org/en/members/list-of-members/list-of-members/member/Member/show/nektarios-tavernarakis/ |title=Prof. Dr. Nektarios Tavernarakis|publisher=leopoldina.org}}</ref> and the [[European Academy of Sciences and Arts]] (EASA).<ref name="EASA">{{cite web|url=https://members.euro-acad.eu/ |title=European Academy of Sciences and Arts members |publisher=euro-acad.eu}}</ref> He is also a corresponding member of the [[Academy of Athens (modern)|Academy of Athens]],<ref name="AcadAth">{{cite web|url=http://www.academyofathens.gr/el/announcements/%CE%B4%CE%B5%CE%BB%CF%84%CE%AF%CE%B1-%CF%84%CF%8D%CF%80%CE%BF%CF%85/20190613 |title=Εκλογή του Καθηγητή της Ιατρικής Σχολής του Πανεπιστημίου Κρήτης κ. Νεκτάριου Ταβερναράκη ως αντεπιστέλλοντος μέλους της Ακαδημίας Αθηνών στην Έδρα της Νευροβιολογίας-Βιολογίας της Γήρανσης|publisher=academyofathens.gr}}</ref> and a Fellow of the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]] (AAAS).<ref name="AAAS">{{cite web|url=https://www.aaas.org/news/aaas-announces-leading-scientists-elected-2020-fellows |title=AAAS Announces Leading Scientists Elected as 2020 Fellows |publisher=aaas.org}}</ref>

His work has received several prominent awards and scientific prizes, including two [[European Research Council]] (ERC) Advanced Investigator grant awards (in 2008 and 2016),<ref name="ERC1">{{cite web|url=http://cordis.europa.eu/project/rcn/90207_en.html |title=European Commission : CORDIS : Projects & Results Service: Molecular Basis of Neuronal Ageing |publisher=Cordis.europa.eu |access-date=2015-11-23}}</ref><ref name="ERC2">{{cite web|url=https://erc.europa.eu/sites/default/files/press_release/files/erc_press_release_adg2015_results.pdf |title=ERC Advanced Grants: €647 million from the EU to 277 senior research leaders |publisher=erc.europa.eu |access-date=2016-05-25}}</ref> a [[European Research Council]] (ERC) Proof of Concept grant award,<ref name="ERC3">{{cite web|url=https://erc.europa.eu/sites/default/files/press_release/files/erc-highlight-poc2016-second-results.pdf |title=ERC Proof of Concept Grants: 45 ERC grantees receive top-up innovation funding long-term postdoctoral fellowship, the BioMedical Research Award of the [[Academy of Athens (modern)|Academy of Athens]], the Valergakis Post-Graduate Award of the Hellenic University Club of New York, the Galien Scientific Research Award,<ref name="Galien">{{cite web|url=http://www.prixgalien.gr/en/ |title=Prix Galien: Galien Scientific Research Award |publisher=prixgalien.gr [[Foundation for Research & Technology – Hellas|Foundation for Research and Technology]], and the Empeirikeion Foundation Academic Excellence Prize, among others. He is also the recipient of the Excellence Award,<ref name="Bodossaki Excellence">{{cite web |url=https://www.bodossaki.gr/en/our-initiatives/bodossakis-excellence-award/ |title=Bodossaki Excellence Award |language=en |publisher=Bodossaki.gr }}</ref> and the Scientific Prize for Medicine and Biology,<ref name="Bodossaki Prize">{{cite web |url=https://www.bodossaki.gr/en/our-initiatives/scientific-awards/ |title=Bodossaki Distinguished Young Scientist Awards |language=en |publisher=Bodossaki.gr }}</ref> of the [[:el:Ίδρυμα Μποδοσάκη|Bodossaki Foundation]], which are two of the most competitive scientific distinctions for Greeks, in Greece and abroad. He is the only Greek scientist to have been awarded both these prestigious prizes.

== Research and scientific achievements ==
Nektarios Tavernarakis has contributed to the elucidation of the molecular mechanisms of [[Necrosis|necrotic cell death]] and [[neurodegeneration]], the interplay between cellular [[metabolism]] and [[ageing]], the mechanisms of [[Transduction (physiology)|sensory transduction]] and integration by the nervous system.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/?term=Tavernarakis+N|title=Tavernarakis N - PubMed|website=Ncbi.nlm.nih.gov}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=Nektarios+Tavernarakis|title=Nektarios Tavernarakis - Google Scholar|website=scholar.google.com}}</ref>  He has also contributed towards the development of novel genetic tools for biomedical research, including an [[RNA interference]] (RNAi) method that allows efficient knockdown of neuronal genes.<ref>{{cite journal|title=Heritable and inducible genetic interference by double-stranded RNA encoded by transgenes|first1=Nektarios|last1=Tavernarakis|first2=Shi L.|last2=Wang|first3=Maxim|last3=Dorovkov|first4=Alexey|last4=Ryazanov|first5=Monica|last5=Driscoll|date=1 February 2000|journal=Nature Genetics|volume=24|issue=2|pages=180–183|doi=10.1038/72850|pmid=10655066|s2cid=24334113}}</ref> His PhD Thesis research focused on the expression and function of key stress response transcriptional activators in the yeast ''[[Saccharomyces cerevisiae]]'', and provided original insights on the regulation of these activators by nutrient limitation, and the role of DNA in determining interactions between [[transcription factor]]s and co-factors.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://thesis.ekt.gr/3450|title=Διατριβή: Ο ΜΕΤΑΓΡΑΦΙΚΟΣ ΕΝΕΡΓΟΠΟΙΗΤΗΣ GCNH: ΜΕΛΕΤΗ ΤΗΣ ΕΚΦΡΑΣΗΣ ΚΑΙ ΤΟΥ ΜΗΧΑΝΙΣΜΟΥ ΛΕΙΤΟΥΡΓΙΑΣ ΤΟΥ - Κωδικός: 3450|website=thesis.ekt.gr}}</ref> His laboratory at IMBB was the first to commence ''[[Caenorhabditis elegans]]'' research in [[Greece]]. He has published more than 285 papers in [[peer-reviewed]] [[scientific journals]], such as [[Nature (journal)|Nature]]. His work has received more than 67,000 [[citations]], with an [[h-index]] of 91.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Nektarios Tavernarakis Google Scholar|url=https://scholar.google.gr/citations?user=afQKKl8AAAAJ&hl|website=scholar.google.ch}}</ref> Among the notable discoveries of his team are the sophisticated molecular mechanisms, by which == Science advocacy ==
Nektarios Tavernarakis has been active in science policy, research governance and public advocacy for basic research. His public engagement has focused on research funding, scientific governance, international collaboration, and the role of science in economic development and evidence-informed policymaking.<ref>{{cite web |title=Why I stepped into governance |website=EMBO |date=22 April 2026 |url=https://www.embo.org/people/why-i-stepped-into-governance-and-never-looked-back/}}</ref> He has argued that curiosity-driven, frontier research is the foundation of technological innovation and long-term economic competitiveness.

In a widely publicized, opinion article published in the scientific journal ''[[EMBO Reports]]'', he argued that major technological advances arise from decades of investment in fundamental science and cautioned against research policies that prioritize short-term applications at the expense of basic research.<ref>{{cite journal |vauthors=Tavernarakis N |title=For the love of frontier research, or why Elon's rockets keep blowing up |journal=EMBO Reports |volume=26 |year=2025 |doi=10.1038/s44319-025-00587-2 |pmid=41023442 |doi-access=free |pmc=12549840 }}</ref> He has also commented extensively on the development of the Greek research ecosystem. In interviews with the [[European Molecular Biology Organization]] (EMBO), he argued that strengthening research infrastructure, reducing administrative burdens, providing predictable long-term funding and attracting international scientific talent are essential for improving Greece's competitiveness in research and innovation.<ref>{{cite web |title=Perspectives on the life sciences in Greece |website=EMBO |url=https://www.embo.org/people/perspectives-on-the-life-sciences-in-greece/}}</ref>

Tavernarakis has consistently promoted interdisciplinary research in the life sciences. In interviews published by ''[[The FEBS Journal]]'' and the FEBS Network, he encouraged molecular and cell biologists to engage with research beyond their immediate specialization, arguing that many important advances emerge at the interface of biology with computational science, engineering and artificial intelligence.<ref>{{cite journal |title=Editor Profile: Nektarios Tavernarakis |journal=The FEBS Journal |volume=288 |issue=20 |year=2021 |pages=5974–5977 |doi=10.1111/febs.15892}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Nektarios Tavernarakis: Molecular and cell biologists should be actively interested in research beyond their immediate specialization |website=FEBS Network |url=https://network.febs.org/posts/nektarios-tavernarakis-molecular-and-cell-biologists-should-be-actively-interested-in-research-beyond-their-immediate-specialization}}</ref>

In interviews with the national Greek newspaper ''[[To Vima]]'', Tavernarakis has argued that scientific research constitutes an important component of national resilience, technological sovereignty and economic prosperity. He has advocated sustained public investment in research and innovation and emphasized that scientific excellence should be treated as a long-term national strategic priority.<ref>{{cite news |title=Νεκτάριος Ταβερναράκης: Η επιστήμη είναι στοιχείο κυριαρχίας και ανθεκτικότητας |date=15 May 2026 |url=https://www.tovima.gr/2026/05/15/politics/nektarios-tavernarakis-i-epistimi-einai-stoixeio-kyriarxias-kai-anthektikotitas/|website=Tovima.gr}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Έρευνα, Καινοτομία και Βήμα |website=Tovima.gr|url=https://www.tovima.gr/print/afieromata/ereyna-kainotomia-kai-vima/}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Nektarios Tavernarakis is married and the father of two daughters. He is a licensed radio amateur, active mainly in the [[VHF]], [[UHF]] and [[Super high frequency|SHF]] radio bands. His callsign is SV9IOR.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.qrz.com/db/SV9IOR|title=SV9IOR Callsign Page|website=QRZ Callsign Database|access-date=November 7, 2026}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://aprs.fi/info/a/SV9IOR|title=Just a second|website=Aprs.fi|access-date=November 7, 2026}}</ref>
